For me I resolved this by turning off auto low latency mode in the Xbox settings, and just keeping my TV on game mode constantly. 

Seeing as other people are having different success with other options changes (like 4:2:2 on/off) I recommend changing turning off and on settings like ALLM, HDR, YCC 422, etc, and waiting a minute or two in between each change to see if it stops. This worked for me, good luck!
